comment: Resident pointer to the 0x718-byte archive/stream manager allocated by afs_manager_allocate; afs_startup_load_partitions reads its archive metadata buffers and group counts for eager loading.

name: memory_card_messages
comment: English 48-entry memory-card status message pointer bank; memory_card_message_get selects a four-byte status pointer with 0xC0-byte language stride from this base.
